task.goal: In Simple Calendar Pro, create a calendar event for this Saturday at 0h with the title 'Appointment for Campaign' and the description 'We will understand upcoming project milestones.'. The event should last for 45 mins.
task.final_summary: Created the event "Appointment for Campaign" in Simple Calendar Pro for Saturday, October 21, 2023, from 00:00 to 00:45 (45 minutes), with the description "We will understand upcoming project milestones." I read it back on the Oct 21 day view and all details match.
